The '''''Corellian Gambit''''' was a [[light hauler]] captained by [[Shandy Fanaso]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] converted its hold into a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], dubbed "Shandy's Place".
